advisories.reason: The vulnerable native image codecs are installed through Transformers.js, but kb-graph invokes only the text feature-extraction pipeline. Upgrading Transformers.js is tracked separately because npm currently offers only a semver-major remediation.
advisories.affectedSurface: @huggingface/transformers@3.8.1 -> sharp@0.34.5; runtime embedding generation uses Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 text input and does not call image decoding.
